notes.title: Leftie Mode added!
notes.content:
Kubbing should be equally fun for everyone, right? So as requested by quite a few users, we now have a Leftie Mode! You can set you preferred hand in the Game Settings

Happy Kubbing!

notes.title: Kubbing Community Event + Fred got Smarter!
notes.content:
Hi there,

we've done another update to the game, this time with more focus on Fred (that's how we call our Bot).

Before going into details, let me invite you to our community event tommorow @ 15th of March 7:30 UTC. If you crave for some kubbing, you really should check it out. No matter if you're Newbie or Pro, we're gonna have a great time! If you can't make it, join our Discord anyway for more Events to come!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qqf2hDv4/Kubbingchallenge.png[/img]

Discord:  https://discord.gg/kKGstsQ

Going on to the Changelog:

IMPROVEMENT: We've improved the Bot's capabilities. He can now teleport and will generally play smarter!
IMPROVEMENT: We've adjusted some sound files to make the experience more pleasant
BALANCE: First player now only will receive 3 knifes in first round
BUG: Kubbs falling were sometimes not registered properly, this should now not happen again.
BUG: Sometimes, Kubbs were not respawned on round change (if they were moving during change), this should not happen anymore

Hope you like those changes, see you at the event!

notes.title: Squash those bugs and experimental WMR Support
notes.content:
Howdy Vikings,

yesterday, we've run our first community event! We had a great time and crowned our first King of Kubbs. We're planning more similar events in the future.

If you want to meet nice people for playing the game or get in touch with the devs, please join our Discord: https://discord.gg/kKGstsQ

Everyone's welcome, new Vicubs (sorry for the really bad pun!) and Kubb Veterans alike!

Coming to the technical stuff: We released a minor update to address the following issues:

- Fixed an issue where Kubbs sometimes"ghosted" and became unhittable
- Fixed an issue for player who started the game did not properly connect and couln't find games
- Fixed an issue that ranking points were awarded even in rematches
- Added [u][b]Experimental[/b][/u] WMR support. [b]If you try this, please let us know your feedback how well this works! (ideally in Discord)[/b]! We don't have a WMR headset, so we rely on your input to get this done!

That's it for today, we continue to work hard on our little gem! We've gotten very good suggestions by our community, so if you have ideas for the game, let us know!

notes.title: Another day, another Update!
notes.content:
We've worked tirelessly and released a new patch!

- Improved: Integrated the Intro animation into the Main Menu for even faster game start :)

- Fixed: Issue with the game sometimes not progressing properly
- Fixed: Issue with Matchmaking when starting a match on first Start of the game ever
- Fixed: Occasionally, the Wardrobe Items did not appear when opening the Wardrobe

notes.title: Matchmaking improved & Rift S and Quest (linked) support added
notes.content:
Hello Vikings! Thank you so much for all that feedback you gave us. We're still looking at some things that don't satisfy our inner Viking, but we're happy to report we managed to solve some issues:

- Fixed wonky controls on Rift S & Oculus Quest. You can now Kubb on with those Headsets!
- Fixed and issue when Matchmaking connected you to someone too far away to go on your  boat. Oopsie!!

Stay with us, more to come!
